title: Unit 4 第三课时 基础达标与综合拓展

sections.title: I. 从方框中选择合适的词或短语填空
sections.instruction: 从方框中选择合适的词或短语填空。

questions.prompt:
1. —Are you ______ on Sunday?
—Yes. I have nothing(没有什么事) to do.
questions.translation:
—— 你周日有空吗？
—— 是的，我没什么事可做。
questions.explanation: 由答语“I have nothing to do”可知周日有空，用形容词 free（空闲的）。故填 free。

questions.prompt: 2. I don't like the movie. I think it's ______.
questions.translation: 我不喜欢这部电影。我觉得它很无聊。
questions.explanation: 由“I don't like the movie”可知觉得电影无聊，用形容词 boring（无聊的）。故填 boring。

questions.prompt: 3. My father is very ______. He works for 12 hours every day.
questions.translation: 我父亲非常忙。他每天工作12个小时。
questions.explanation: 由“He works for 12 hours every day”可知父亲很忙碌，用形容词 busy（忙碌的）。故填 busy。

questions.prompt: 4. Some people think English is too(太) ______.
questions.translation: 有些人认为英语太难了。
questions.explanation: too 后面接形容词 difficult（困难的），符合句意。故填 difficult。

questions.prompt: 5. Mr. Gao is an ______ teacher. He often plays games with us.
questions.translation: 高老师是一位有趣的老师。他经常和我们一起玩游戏。
questions.explanation: an 后面接以元音音素开头的形容词 interesting（有趣的），修饰 teacher。故填 interesting。

questions.prompt: 6. We learn how to ______ math problems.
questions.translation: 我们学习如何解决数学难题。
questions.explanation: “解决/算出数学题”固定短语为 work out。故填 work out。

questions.prompt: 7. I want to be a ______ in the future.
questions.translation: 我将来想成为一名科学家。
questions.explanation: a 后面接单数职业名词 scientist（科学家）。故填 scientist。

sections.title: II. 用适当的介词填空

questions.prompt: 1. What classes do you have ______ Friday morning?
questions.translation: 你周五上午有什么课？
questions.explanation: 在具体的某天上午用介词 on。故填 on。

questions.prompt: 2. Mike likes playing soccer ______ his friends after school.
questions.translation: 放学后迈克喜欢和他的朋友们一起踢足球。
questions.explanation: “和某人一起”用介词 with。故填 with。

questions.translation: 我们从11:50到1:00吃午饭。
questions.explanation: from... to... 表示“从……到……”。故填 from; to。

questions.prompt: 4. Do you have a music festival ______ June?
questions.translation: 你们在六月份有音乐节吗？
questions.explanation: 在具体的某个月份用介词 in。故填 in。

questions.prompt: 5. The meeting(会议) is ______ 2:30 in the afternoon.
questions.translation: 会议在下午两点半开始。
questions.explanation: 在具体的时间点前用介词 at。故填 at。

sections.title: III. 根据句意及汉语提示完成句子
sections.instruction: 根据句意及汉语提示写出单词的正确形式。

questions.prompt: 1. I like English because it is interesting and ______ (有用的).
questions.translation: 我喜欢英语，因为它既有趣又实用。
questions.explanation: 根据汉语提示“有用的”，形容词为 useful。故填 useful。

questions.prompt: 2. ______ (星期天) is the day after Saturday and before Monday.
questions.translation: 星期天是星期六之后、星期一之前的一天。
questions.explanation: 根据汉语提示“星期天”，名词为 Sunday，句首首字母大写。故填 Sunday。

questions.prompt: 3. They are not busy today. They are ______ (空闲的).
questions.translation: 他们今天不忙。他们很清闲。
questions.explanation: 根据汉语提示“空闲的”，形容词为 free。故填 free。

questions.prompt: 4. The soccer season(足球赛季) usually ______ (结束) in May.
questions.translation: 足球赛季通常在五月结束。
questions.explanation: 主语 The soccer season 为单数第三人称，usually 表一般现在时，“结束”用动词 finishes（或 ends）。故填 finishes。

questions.prompt: 5. After school, Yu Ying has an art lesson for two ______ (小时).
questions.translation: 放学后，于莹上两个小时的美术课。
questions.explanation: 基数词 two 后接可数名词复数，“小时”复数为 hours。故填 hours。

sections.title: IV. 完形填空
sections.instruction: 通读下面短文，掌握其大意，然后在各题所给的四个选项中选出一个最佳答案。
sections.passage:
Jack is my good friend. He likes [1]. He plays the drums well. He starts a band(乐队) with his friends, Dave and Linda. They want to [2] the music club at school. Dave does well [3] singing and playing the guitar. Linda can play the piano [4]. Their band doesn't have a [5], so they want a good name for it. They [6] and play their own(自己的) songs. They don't have [7] to play the instruments at school, so they always play them on the weekend. They play for two hours. After that, they are very [8].

Jackson is one of the members (成员) of a Chinese band. He sings Jack's song, and it's very famous. Jack and his friends [9] the song very much. They want to [10] with him. They also want to sing along with him one day.

questions.translation: 他喜欢音乐。他鼓敲得很好。
questions.explanation: 后句说敲鼓敲得好且组建乐队，说明他喜欢“音乐（music）”。故选 music。

questions.translation: 他们想加入学校的音乐俱乐部。
questions.explanation: 加入俱乐部用动词 join。故选 join。

questions.translation: 戴夫在唱歌和弹吉他方面做得很好。
questions.explanation: do well in sth. 在某方面做得好，固定搭配。故选 in。

questions.translation: 琳达钢琴弹得很好。
questions.explanation: 修饰动词 play the piano 用副词 well。故选 well。

questions.translation: 他们的乐队还没有名字，所以他们想给它起个好名字。
questions.explanation: 由后半句“so they want a good name for it”可知乐队还没有“名字（name）”。故选 name。

questions.translation: 他们谱写并演奏他们自己的歌曲。
questions.explanation: write songs 意为“写歌、创作歌曲”，与 play their own songs 并列。故选 write。

questions.translation: 他们在学校没有时间弹奏乐器，所以他们总是在周末演奏。
questions.explanation: 根据后句“so they always play them on the weekend”可知在学校没有“时间（time）”。故选 time。

questions.translation: 在那之后，他们非常开心。
questions.explanation: 玩了喜爱的乐器之后感到“开心（happy）”。故选 happy。

questions.translation: 杰克和他的朋友们非常喜欢这首歌。
questions.explanation: 主语 Jack and his friends 为复数，谓语动词用原形 like。故选 like。

questions.translation: 他们想和他交朋友。
questions.explanation: make friends with sb. 表示“和某人交朋友”，符合语境。故选 make friends。

sections.title: V. 阅读理解
sections.instruction: 阅读下列短文，从每题所给的四个选项中选出最佳答案。
sections.passage:
There are many kinds of subjects in school. Do you know "labor (劳动) class"? It's different from other subjects. According to *People's Daily*, a study shows that our Chinese students only spend 12 minutes a day on average(平均) on housework, less than(少于) 72 minutes in the US, 42 minutes in South Korea and 30 minutes in France. So many schools open labor class to help more students live better. I'm very happy to hear that. But do you know what we can learn from it?

On the one hand, we can learn living skills from it. The teacher will teach us quite a lot of useful skills, such as planting trees, growing tomatoes, keeping pets, cooking and so on. Maybe these life skills are easy for adults(成年人), but kind of difficult for us to learn them well. On the other hand, we can also be great helpers for our parents. As we know, parents are very busy with their work and they are usually tired after a day's work. If we can take care of (照顾) ourselves well and help them when they need, they will feel relaxed and we will feel happy, too.

questions.prompt: 1. Who may be the writer?
questions.translation: 作者可能是一名什么人？—— 一名学生。
questions.explanation: 根据第二段“but kind of difficult for us to learn them well. On the other hand, we can also be great helpers for our parents.”可知作者站在学生的角度来叙述。故选 A student。

questions.prompt: 2. Which of the following CAN'T we learn from labor class?
questions.translation: 下面哪一项我们不能在劳动课上学到？—— 数学。
questions.explanation: 第二段明确提到“planting trees, growing tomatoes, keeping pets, cooking and so on”，不包括数学（math）。故选 math。

questions.prompt: 3. Why should we help our parents with housework?
options: Because it is good for study.
Because it is easy for us to do housework well.
Because they are too busy with their work and they are tired.
Because we have to help them.
questions.translation: 为什么我们应该帮父母做家务？—— 因为他们工作太忙而且很累。
questions.explanation: 根据第二段“As we know, parents are very busy with their work and they are usually tired after a day's work.”可知原因。故选 Because they are too busy with their work and they are tired。

questions.prompt: 4. What's the main idea of this passage?
questions.translation: 这篇文章的主旨大意是什么？—— 劳动课。
questions.explanation: 全文围绕学校开设劳动课（Labor class）的背景、开设目的以及学生能从中学习到的技能展开，主旨是劳动课。故选 Labor class。

sections.title: VI. (2025·广东)完形填空
sections.instruction: 通读下面短文，掌握其大意，然后在各题所给的三个选项中选出一个最佳答案。
sections.passage:
Lily works as a main cook in a famous restaurant. It was her mom who guided her into the world of cooking.

When she was a little girl, Lily spent a lot of time with mom in the kitchen. She remembered that she would always sit there [1] watch mom cooking. She was curious about [2] mom was busy with. When she was older, she [3] to do easy tasks like beating eggs. Later on, while mom was making dumplings, Lily would help cut vegetables [4] a small knife. She also learned how to make dumplings of [5] shapes. To a girl of her age, cooking was real magic. As Lily grew up, she learned more about food and tried cooking [6] dishes than before. After finishing college, she decided [7] in a restaurant. With wild imagination, she came up with many new ideas and started to create [8] own dishes. So far, she [9] many dishes with special tastes. All these dishes are popular with customers.

Today, the kitchen is still a place for Lily and mom to have [10] fun together. Every time before a family dinner party, they will cooperate to plan a menu. Cooking has kept their mother-daughter relationship strong.

questions.translation: 她记得自己总是坐在那里看着妈妈做饭。
questions.explanation: sit there 与 watch mom cooking 是顺承并列动作，用连词 and 连接。故选 and。

questions.translation: 她对妈妈忙碌的事情感到好奇。
questions.explanation: be busy with 后缺少宾语，引导宾语从句且作介词 with 的宾语用连接代词 what。故选 what。

questions.translation: 当她渐渐长大一些，她被允许做一些简单的事情，比如打蛋。
questions.explanation: 全文讲述过去的事情，用一般过去时的被动语态 was allowed。故选 was allowed。

questions.translation: 莉莉会用一把小刀帮忙切菜。
questions.explanation: 使用某种具体工具用介词 with。故选 with。

questions.translation: 她还学会了包不同形状的饺子。
questions.explanation: 修饰名词复数 shapes 用形容词 different（不同的）。故选 different。

questions.translation: 尝试烹饪比以前难度更大的菜肴。
questions.explanation: 句中有比较连词 than before，应用形容词比较级 more difficult。故选 more difficult。

questions.translation: 大学毕业后，她决定在一家餐厅工作。
questions.explanation: decide to do sth. 决定做某事，接不定式 to work。故选 to work。

questions.translation: 并且开始自创属于她自己的菜品。
questions.explanation: one's own 是固定搭配，主语是 she，用形容词性物主代词 her。故选 her。

questions.translation: 到目前为止，她已经研发出了许多口味独特的菜肴。
questions.explanation: So far（到目前为止）是现在完成时的标志词，主语 she 是单数第三人称，用 has invented。故选 has invented。

questions.translation: 今天，厨房依然是莉莉和妈妈一起享受乐趣的地方。
questions.explanation: have fun 是固定短语，表示“过得愉快/享受乐趣”，中间不加冠词。故选 /。
